cd /workspace/submission && python3 -c "
import ast, sys
tree = ast.parse(open('main.py').read())
# find defined top-level names and simple usage counts
src = open('main.py').read()
defs = [n.name for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef, ast.ClassDef))]
assigns = [t.id for n in tree.body if isinstance(n, ast.Assign) for t in n.targets if isinstance(t, ast.Name)]
for name in defs + assigns:
    if name.startswith('_') and name not in ('_ERROR','_EMPTY_RRSET'):
        pass
    count = src.count(name)
    if count <= 2 and name not in ('main','Invalid','analyze'):
        print('possibly unused:', name, count)
" ; python3 -m py_compile main.py && echo "compiles"; wc -l main.py; ls -la /workspace/submission
